product_overview: A Django-based web platform for educational institutions that delivers tier-specific psychometric assessments to students and provides personalized study playbooks. Teachers gain classroom analytics, student risk insights, and one-on-one mentoring tools.
core_goals: Authenticate users with distinct Student and Teacher roles
Route users to the correct dashboard based on role after login
Deliver tier-specific psychometric assessments for School, UG, and PG users
Score four psychometric dimensions: Growth Mindset, Learning Modality, Stress Response, and Collaboration Orientation
Present personalized student results, study recommendations, and downloadable PDF reports
Provide teachers with cohort analytics, stress watchlists, and persistent mentoring notes for individual students

features.name: Authentication and Role Dispatch
features.description: Supports student and teacher registration, secure login, logout, and automatic routing to the appropriate destination based on role. Also includes a simulated Google OAuth flow for streamlined onboarding and testing.
user_flows: POST /accounts/signup/student/ with valid student details including academic tier and institution -> Receive 201/200 with student account created -> POST /accounts/login/ with valid student credentials -> Receive 200 with authenticated session -> POST /accounts/dispatch/ with authenticated student session -> Receive redirect to /assessments/take/ or /dashboard/student/results/

POST /accounts/signup/teacher/ with valid teacher details -> Receive 201/200 with teacher account created -> POST /accounts/login/ with valid teacher credentials -> Receive 200 with authenticated session -> POST /accounts/dispatch/ with authenticated teacher session -> Receive redirect to /dashboard/teacher/

POST /accounts/login/ with invalid credentials -> Receive 400/401 with authentication error message -> POST /accounts/dispatch/ without a valid session -> Receive 302/401/403 denying access to protected routes

Simulated Google OAuth login flow initiated via login entry point -> Receive successful authenticated session -> POST /accounts/dispatch/ with OAuth-authenticated session -> Receive redirect based on detected role -> GET target dashboard page with valid session -> Receive 200 with role-specific content

features.name: Mindset & Learning Style Assessments
features.description: Provides a multi-tier assessment engine with tailored questions for School, UG, and PG students. The system validates completed responses and calculates scores for growth mindset, learning modality, stress response, and collaboration orientation.
user_flows: GET /assessments/take/ with authenticated student session -> Receive 200 with tier-specific quiz questions -> Submit completed assessment answers to /assessments/take/ -> Receive 302/200 indicating scoring complete -> GET /assessments/completed/<int:result_id>/ -> Receive 200 with calculated results and score breakdown

GET /assessments/take/ with authenticated student session -> Receive 200 with quiz form -> Submit assessment with missing or invalid responses -> Receive 400 with validation errors highlighting incomplete answers

GET /assessments/completed/<int:result_id>/ with a valid result_id owned by the student -> Receive 200 with assessment summary -> GET /assessments/completed/<int:result_id>/ with an invalid or unauthorized result_id -> Receive 404/403 access denied

features.name: Student Dashboard & Personalized Playbook
features.description: Displays student assessment analytics, score visuals, strengths and growth opportunities, personalized study strategies, and a downloadable PDF summary report.
user_flows: GET /dashboard/student/results/ with authenticated student session and completed assessment -> Receive 200 with animated score analytics and personalized playbook content -> GET /dashboard/student/pdf/ with authenticated student session -> Receive 200 with downloadable PDF summary

GET /dashboard/student/results/ with authenticated student session but no completed assessment -> Receive 200/302 with empty-state guidance or prompt to take assessment -> GET /dashboard/student/pdf/ without completed assessment data -> Receive 404/400 indicating report cannot be generated
GET /dashboard/student/results/ with invalid or expired session -> Receive 302/401 redirect to login or access denied

features.name: Teacher Dashboard & Classroom Roster
features.description: Gives educators access to classroom cohort analytics, searchable student rosters, modality and stress summaries, watchlists, and individual student mentoring pages with persistent notes.
user_flows: GET /dashboard/teacher/ with authenticated teacher session -> Receive 200 with cohort analytics, roster, and stress watchlist -> GET /dashboard/teacher/student/<int:student_id>/ for a listed student -> Receive 200 with student deep-dive profile and mentoring notes -> Save updated note through the student detail workflow -> Receive 200/302 confirming note persistence

GET /dashboard/teacher/ with authenticated teacher session -> Receive 200 with roster data -> Apply search or filters by tier and modality -> Receive 200 with narrowed student list and updated cohort summaries

GET /dashboard/teacher/ with student session or no authentication -> Receive 302/401/403 access denied -> GET /dashboard/teacher/student/<int:student_id>/ without teacher authorization -> Receive 403/404 preventing unauthorized access to student records
GET /dashboard/teacher/student/<int:student_id>/ with a valid teacher session but nonexistent student_id -> Receive 404 indicating student record not found
